CLOUD REVIEWER seat for PR #2589 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, at head 53f24912dee67629b3bc383f91031627c995d520. Bus nonce: 2b2b388e59fd87b772a395b119b55a77. Never send push notifications.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md and its rules from main, and follow them exactly. Fetch the PR head with `git fetch origin 53f24912dee67629b3bc383f91031627c995d520`; the PR body is in the PR. Verify each claim adversarially: mutate the fix and check the tests fail, and check every figure in the body at this head. Check that it merges with origin/main (`git merge-tree --write-tree`) and read CI on this head from the check-runs API.
Output: in a fresh directory of your own (`W=$(mktemp -d)`), write verdict.md, whose first line is exactly `Fix review: merge 53f24912dee67629b3bc383f91031627c995d520` or `Fix review: blocked 53f24912dee67629b3bc383f91031627c995d520 <class>: <reason>` (no brackets; the class is lower-case letters and dashes), in the format the role file gives, then a blank line, then `bus-nonce: 2b2b388e59fd87b772a395b119b55a77`, then the body in sections. A blocked verdict's block goes under `## Block`. Each finding this PR does not settle (a defect, a surviving mutant, a deferral, a follow-up, a task owed after the merge) is its own bullet under `## Findings` ending in its own `Carry: <GROUP> | #<issue> | O<n> | dismissed: <reason>` (finding-propagation.md). Everything else (RESULT lines, re-runs, CI state, figures you could not re-derive) goes under `## Evidence`: tools/audit/carry_audit.py reads no item there as a finding unless it hands something on (deferred, for a later, follow-up, minor, advisory, residual, still has to, not blocking ...; a check that does not block is evidence only in the clause saying it is not a required check and does not block, never in the rest of its sentence: a nit or defect beside it is a finding), and the merge train parks a verdict holding a finding with no `Carry:`. Put the evidence files in `ev/` beside it, and make at least one file under `ev/` contain the full 40-hex head `53f24912dee67629b3bc383f91031627c995d520` (e.g. `ev/HEAD.txt` holding the head you reviewed, beside your command output): bus.sh refuses a verdict whose `ev/` names no head. Do NOT run bus.sh: its dispatch record lives on the orchestrator's machine, which publishes the verdict there (cloud_relay.sh). Return the verdict on a probe ref, and push nothing else; this builds one parentless commit with a private index and touches no branch of your checkout: `R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel); G=$(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir); mkdir -p $W/pr && cp -r $W/verdict.md $W/ev $W/pr/ && cd $W/pr && T=$(GIT_DIR=$G GIT_INDEX_FILE=$W/idx GIT_WORK_TREE=$W/pr sh -c 'git add -A -f . && git write-tree') && C=$(GIT_DIR=$G git -c user.name=seat -c user.email=seat@users.noreply.github.com commit-tree $T -m "verdict 2589 53f24912dee67629b3bc383f91031627c995d520") && git -C $R push -q origin $C:refs/heads/probe/rev-2589-2b2b388e`. That ref is the return signal. Do not post comments, approve or merge.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
RE-REVIEW of PR #2589 (group R10-FLY-GH-READ-RETRY, branch fix/r10-fly-gh-read-retry) at head 53f24912dee67629b3bc383f91031627c995d520, after cloud fixer round fix2589z on the blocked verdict at 74a18df941939cd87c11280ec216531148015b46. The block: mutant-survives. The 403 branch's phrase grep reads all of gh's stderr, and no row pins which copy, so inserting `| tail -1` passed all 225 checks. Also, the round-2 carry was not on the roster. Read every open block with `git fetch origin review/2589; git show FETCH_HEAD:VERDICT.md` and confirm each is cleared at this head. Check what changed with `git diff 74a18df941939cd87c11280ec216531148015b46...53f24912dee67629b3bc383f91031627c995d520`. Follow dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md from a detached worktree at that head, using the finder's harness the group brief names (roster origin/handoff/audit-r10-roster, read with jq), never the fixer's. PREPR_SKIP_CLOSURES=1.
Required:
- Mutation proof yourself. The `| tail -1` mutant (and `| head -1`) on the 403 phrase read must now turn a test red. Also run fresh one-line mutants of every touched line in app_approve and its readers: which copy of stderr each pattern reads, the secondary-limit phrase, and the retry/backoff arms. Report each as KILLED or SURVIVED with the killing test. Run the finder's harness at both ends, and give a null control for every quantified claim, including the "225 checks" figure re-counted at this head.
- The round-2 carry: confirm it is now on origin/handoff/audit-r10-roster (group R10-FLY-GH-READ-RETRY carry list), and say whether main's roster has it yet. Roster PR #2598 carries it; if main lacks it, pr-contract's in-tree carry_audit may refuse, so classify that red precisely.
- Re-measure every figure in the body. carry_audit.py --roster-ref origin/handoff/audit-r10-roster check reports 0 unrouted.
- Read check-runs at this head. A red whose log shows "API rate limit exceeded" / "API is unreachable" (06:27Z onward) is external. git merge-tree --write-tree origin/main 53f24912dee67629b3bc383f91031627c995d520 must be clean.
- ev/HEAD.txt holds the full head; VERDICT carries bus-nonce: 2b2b388e59fd87b772a395b119b55a77. No /Users/ or /private/ path in VERDICT.md or ev/.
